review.brief: Review RM36-app-record-poll-run (tier 2, final, of RM36; ticket MAG-35) against its artifacts. Scope: commits 8a56d41, 9757579, 2b70310, 5b8b56c on ft/RM36-MAG-35-poll-run-tracking - read the DIFF, not the whole module. Validate: (1) internal/app still owns NO data - no pgxpool, no query, no internal/telemetry/db import; it calls the RunWriter port only; (2) the internal/clock rule - no NEW raw time.Now(); the two in processor.go are pre-existing and grandfathered until RM35-app-adopt-clock; (3) design D4 - the guarded fall-through must preserve the short-circuit exactly (steps 2/3 iff step 1 succeeded) AND guarantee recordRun on every exit path; (4) design D5 - a RecordRun failure must not alter ProcessVehicleData return values; (5) design D7 - buildPollRun pure, by-field mapping per tier 1 D8, nil-map safe; (6) spec/tasks coverage and the ADDED requirement; (7) the test-contract rule - fixtures P1-P5 must assert design.md Test Contract values, not back-fitted ones; (8) anti-gaming - no weakened criteria, no production code bent to make a test pass; (9) SPECIAL: audit the migration renumber in 2b70310 for correctness and completeness, and check whether any OTHER migration version number collides across internal/*/db/migrations - the shared goose_db_version table makes a duplicate silently unappliable.

findings.note: internal/account/db/migrations/20260720000001_vehicles_add_access_type.sql and internal/charging/db/migrations/20260720000001_require_location_kind.sql share version 20260720000001. Makefile MIGRATIONS_DIRS orders account before charging and goose keeps one shared goose_db_version table (Makefile lines 26-28, 39-48), so applying account 20260720000001 first records that version and goose silently skips charging 20260720000001_require_location_kind.sql on a fresh apply -- the exact failure mode 2b70310 just fixed for poll_runs, but for the manual_charge_entries.location_kind NOT NULL constraint. ai/go-conventions.md already names this pair ("internal/account and internal/charging both ship a 20260720000001") in the ProvisionDirs discussion but frames it only as a test-provisioning fact, not as a live production/migrate-up risk -- it is the same shared-table mechanism the Makefile itself documents two paragraphs later. Not introduced by this tier and outside internal/app, but the review brief explicitly asked for a full collision sweep and states any duplicate found is a blocker. No DATABASE_URL is configured in this worktree so I could not run make migrate-status to confirm the live database state; recommend the leader run it and, if confirmed, renumber charging 20260720000001 (mirroring 2b70310) before archiving this change or as an immediate follow-up.

rounds.notes: app code itself is correct and matches design D1-D9 exactly (verified against the diff, not the whole module); zero production drift between wave A and wave B; go build/vet/gofmt clean. Sole blocker is a second, pre-existing cross-module migration-version collision (account/charging, both 20260720000001) found during the mandated collision sweep -- unrelated to internal/app but explicitly in scope per the brief.

decisions.decision: User instructed the pipeline to implement tier 2 and then close MAG-35, rather than closing the ticket on tier 1 alone.
decisions.why: Tier 1 built the table and the counting but nothing writes a row; the ticket's asks are only observable once app records the run.

decisions.decision: No design gate run for this tier: it creates and alters no database object, calling only tier 1's already-gated poll_runs schema through the RunWriter port.
decisions.why: The database gate fires on schema/object changes. Leader confirmed the artifacts add no migration, column, or index; the worker was told to block if it needed one.

decisions.decision: Batched tasks.md's 5 declared waves into 2 serial worker dispatches (A: 1.1-2.4 plus 4.1; B: 3.1-3.5 plus 5.1-5.4) along the real dependency cuts.
decisions.why: All 16 tasks share one module and one worker identity. Five dispatches would re-read the full doc pack five times. Every depends_on is still honoured inside each batch.

decisions.decision: User explicitly instructed the assistant to run the test suite and cmd/poller --once itself, overriding the project's standing Test-Execution-Policy for this session.
decisions.why: Direct owner instruction outranks the owner's own standing written rule. Results are recorded as assistant-run under that instruction, never as the owner's verification.

decisions.decision: Leader renumbered tier 1's shipped migration 20260830000001_add_poll_runs.sql to 20260830000002 and applied it, then documented the global-uniqueness rule in the Makefile.
decisions.why: It collided with account's 20260830000001 in the shared goose_db_version table, so goose skipped it and poll_runs never existed. Renumbering was the only fix; the migration had never run.

events.event: Step 3 complete. Worker 'app' (Sonnet) wrote proposal.md, design.md, specs/process-vehicle-data/spec.md and tasks.md; openspec validate --strict reports valid. Leader independently verified the three risk points named in the dispatch: (1) the delta uses ADDED only and its header 'Every Cycle Records A Poll Run Summary' does not collide with the main spec's three existing requirements - the failure that aborted tier 1's archive cannot repeat; (2) design D4 places the record on a guarded fall-through so RecordRun fires on every exit path by construction, and its rejection of a defer closure is technically correct (defer evaluates arguments at defer-time, capturing the zero-value report); (3) design D2 uses internal/clock.Now(), never a raw time.Now(). No database object is added or changed, so no design gate applies (D-LEADER-7).
Step 4 complete. progress.json seeded with 16 sub-tasks across 5 declared waves, all pending.

Step 5 dispatch A: app worker (Sonnet) for tasks 1.1, 1.2, 2.1, 2.2, 2.3, 2.4, 4.1 - the processor wiring, the guarded fall-through refactor, buildPollRun/recordRun, and the cmd/poller composition-root change. Budget at dispatch: five_hour_pct=52, context_pct=21.

Wave A reconciled: all 7 tasks done. Leader independently re-ran go build ./... (clean), go vet ./... (clean - it compiles scheduler_test.go, so the NewProcessor signature change did not drift), gofmt -l internal/app/ cmd/poller/ (empty), and read the full processor.go diff: D4's guarded fall-through preserves the short-circuit exactly (steps 2/3 run iff step 1 succeeded), D5's recordRun returns nothing so it cannot alter the returned error, D7's buildPollRun is pure and nil-map-safe. Grepped for raw time.Now(): the two hits in processor.go are PRE-EXISTING daily-bucket code grandfathered until RM35-app-adopt-clock; this wave added none, using clock.Now() throughout (D2). Budget 52%->57% five-hour, context 23%.

Step 5 dispatch B: app worker (Sonnet) for tasks 3.1-3.5 (the fake roster and design.md Test Contract fixtures P1-P5) and 5.1-5.4 (internal/app/AGENTS.md updates). Budget at dispatch: five_hour_pct=57, context_pct=23.

Wave B reconciled: docs 5.1-5.4 done; tests 3.1-3.5 awaiting-user-verification (written, never executed by the assistant). Leader independently re-ran go build ./... (clean), go vet ./... (clean, compiles the new processor_test.go and its 8 compile-time interface assertions), gofmt -l internal/app/ (empty), confirmed git diff --stat shows ZERO changes to processor.go/app.go/main.go (no production drift to make a test pass), and diffed Fixture P4 line-by-line against design.md's P4 block: errors.Is on the sentinel, every count field asserted 0, non-zero StartedAt/FinishedAt, DurationSeconds consistent with report.Duration, and AllRegisteredVehicles asserted NOT called - the short-circuit survives the D4 reshape. Exact contract match. Budget 57%->63% five-hour, context 25%.

ASSISTANT-RUN TEST PASS, at the user's explicit instruction (D-USER-2), NOT the owner's own verification. `go test ./internal/app/...` passed, and a -v run confirmed all five fixtures (P1-P5) actually executed rather than skipping. Tasks 3.1-3.5 move awaiting-user-verification -> done.

DEFECT FOUND BY THE SMOKE RUN - tier 1's migration was never applied. `go run ./cmd/poller --once` logged 'poll run: recording run ...: ERROR: relation "poll_runs" does not exist (SQLSTATE 42P01)'. Root cause: telemetry's 20260830000001_add_poll_runs.sql collided with account's 20260830000001_accounts_vehicles_add_status.sql, and all modules share one goose_db_version table keyed by version - goose saw the number recorded, SKIPPED the file, and make migrate-status listed it as 'applied' with the account migration's timestamp. The Makefile's -allow-missing cannot absorb a duplicate number; it only handles out-of-order versions. This passed tier 1's reviewer, its byte-for-byte DDL diff, and every build/vet signal, because all of them check file CONTENTS and the contents were always correct. Only executing the binary against a real database could surface it. Fixed in 2b70310: renumbered to 20260830000002, applied, uniqueness rule documented in the Makefile's MIGRATIONS_DIRS note, correction note added to the archived tier-1 design.md.

END-TO-END PROOF. Second `cmd/poller --once` ran clean with no RecordRun error, and a direct SELECT returned the row: duration_seconds=4.904613, tesla_api_calls=4, accounts 1/1/0, vehicles 2/2, charging_sessions_upserted=6, config_capture_failures=0 - every value matching the printed log line exactly (duration=4.904613s). MAG-35's ask is delivered end to end. Note: the FIRST run also proved design D5 under a real fault - RecordRun failed and the cycle still completed and reported success rather than dying.

Step 7 review brief written; dispatching app-reviewer (Sonnet, escalate on doubt). Brief includes a special item: audit the migration renumber and sweep for any other cross-module version collision. Budget at dispatch: five_hour_pct=71, context_pct=27.
